item.title: Ukraine: Massive wave of daytime Russian strikes hits sites nationwide
item.summary: In one of the largest daytime air strikes since the start of the war, #Russia launched nearly 1,000 drones at various sites in #Ukraine on March 24. The raids claimed several lives and caused damage in various cities, hundreds of kilometres from the front line.
